Job Description Summary:
Our view of digital is one of an integrated ecosystem of platforms that create value across the digital and physical world. Our digital strategy creates value not only for our consumers and customers but across our organization and our system. This position provides analytical support across all lines of business and domains. This role will provide analyst support related to strategic initiatives, data quality and other master data management activities for an assigned master data domain. We’re looking for someone passionate about analytics with a track record of deriving actionable results from data and trends.
What You’ll Do for Us
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve applications supporting our sales execution ecosystem.
Our platforms support critical sales capabilities including promotions, deals, sales execution, and related customer workflows . The technology landscape includes Salesforce, custom web applications, backend APIs and services, SQL Server databases, and integrations with CRM, mobile, web, and other enterprise applications.This is not a traditional Salesforce-only development role. We are looking for a strong full-stack software engineer with meaningful Salesforce development experience who is comfortable working across the entire application and integration stack. The ideal candidate brings strong frontend engineering skills, Salesforce development expertise, backend/API experience, and a solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns.
What You’ll Do
Design, develop, test, and support scalable applications supporting sales execution and customer-facing business capabilities.
Develop modern web experiences using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS .
Build and enhance Salesforce user experiences using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and related Salesforce technologies.
Develop Salesforce business logic and integrations using Apex, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform capabilities .
Design and develop backend services and REST APIs connecting Salesforce with custom applications and enterprise systems.
Develop solutions that interact with SQL Server and other enterprise data sources.
Build and maintain integrations among Salesforce, CRM platforms, mobile applications, web applications, APIs, and backend systems .
Design reliable data flows and integration patterns between systems while maintaining clear boundaries between user experience, business services, and data layers.
Troubleshoot complex issues that span frontend applications, APIs, Salesforce, databases, and downstream integrations.
Write automated unit and integration tests and contribute to engineering quality standards.
Participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and technical discussions.
Support automated build, testing, deployment, and CI/CD practices.
Partner closely with Product, Architecture, Data, QA, Security, and other engineering teams to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions.
Improve existing applications through modernization, simplification, performance improvements, and reduction of technical debt.
Own solutions from design through development, deployment, monitoring, and production support .
Required Qualifications
5–10 years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting enterprise applications.
Strong full-stack development experience across frontend, backend, APIs, and databases.
Hands-on experience developing solutions on the Salesforce platform .
Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce Lightning development.
Strong knowledge of Apex and Salesforce application development.
Experience with SOQL , Salesforce data models, security concepts, and platform development practices.
Strong experience with JavaScript and TypeScript .
Hands-on experience with a modern frontend framework, preferably React .
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating distributed enterprise applications.
Strong backend engineering experience with a modern server-side technology such as Java/Spring Boot, .NET/C#, or equivalent .
Experience working with relational databases, preferably SQL Server , including data modeling, SQL development, and performance considerations.
Experience integrating Salesforce with external enterprise applications.
Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts used in modern APIs and enterprise applications, including OAuth 2.0 .
Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software engineering practices .
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across application layers.
Ability to independently own technical solutions while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional product team.
Preferred Qualifications
Salesforce Platform Developer certification or equivalent hands-on Salesforce development experience.
Experience with Sales Cloud or Salesforce solutions supporting sales execution.
Experience developing applications supporting sales, promotions, deals, pricing, customer, or field execution workflows .
Experience integrating Salesforce with mobile and external web applications.
Experience with event-driven or asynchronous integration architectures.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS .
Understanding of API gateways, application security, observability, logging, and production monitoring.
Experience modernizing legacy integrations or decomposing tightly coupled applications into APIs and reusable services.
Experience working in a product-oriented engineering organization with end-to-end ownership.

Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Job Description Summary:
Role Overview
The Director, AI Engineer is responsible for leading the delivery, adoption, and evolution of artificial intelligence engineering capabilities for one of the prioritized digital products within the Global Digital Network Fuelight . Fuelight 360 is Coca-Cola's enterprise resource allocation and investment optimization capability. It is a tailor-made, always-on System capability that uses advanced data, analytics, AI, and GenAI to help Coca-Cola and its bottling partners make better decisions about where and how to invest marketing and trade spend .
Reporting into the Senior Director, AI Engineering Lead, this role translates enterprise AI engineering strategy into delivery execution, reusable capabilities, and engineering practices to power our Fuelight 360 solution . The Director leads AI engineers and technical specialists while partnering closely with Product, Data Science, Product Engineering, and Core Technology teams to ensure AI solutions achieve intended business outcomes and align with enterprise standards.
The successful candidate is a highly credible technical leader who can operate as a player-coach when needed, balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery execution. They are passionate about developing engineering talent, advancing AI engineering maturity, and helping product teams successfully adopt emerging AI technologies.
What You'll Do for Us
Design, develop, and operationalize AI capabilities within Fuelight 360, translating business and analytical requirements into scalable production solutions
Evaluate, design, and implement generative AI and agent-based solutions that improve decision support, scenario planning, user guidance, and insight generation within Fuelight 360.
Translate enterprise AI strategy, architecture standards, and platform capabilities into actionable Fuelight 360 delivery roadmap and implementation plans.
Provide technical expertise on AI architecture, model integration patterns, and emerging AI technologies to support Fuelight's product roadmap and long-term strategy.
Partner with Fuelight Product Managers, Technical Leads, Data Scientists, and Product Engineering leaders to prioritize and deliver high-value AI solutions
Ensure effective implementation of MLOps , LLMOps , and AgentOps practices, including lifecycle management, deployment automation, observability, monitoring, and operational governance.
Drive adoption of enterprise AI standards, reusable patterns, development tools, and engineering best practices across product teams.
Lead the design, development, deployment, and operation of production AI applications, LLM-powered products, and agent-based solutions.
Manage and develop AI engineering teams, providing coaching, technical direction, performance leadership, and career development.
Establish engineering quality standards through architecture reviews, code reviews, testing practices, and operational readiness assessments.
Partner with Core Technology teams to leverage enterprise AI platforms, orchestration services, and foundational capabilities while identifying opportunities for enhancement.
Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise governance, security, responsible AI, privacy, and risk management requirements.
Drive AI observability and operational excellence through monitoring, evaluation, performance optimization, and continuous improvement practices.
Support the delivery of enterprise digital twin, forecasting, simulation, optimization, and intelligent automation capabilities.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and engineering approaches and recommend opportunities that improve delivery effectiveness and business impact.
Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, collaboration, and engineering excellence across AI engineering teams.
Requirements & Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science , Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
8 + years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, machine learning engineering, platform engineering, or related technical disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical leads, or specialized engineering functions.
Demonstrated experience delivering production AI solutions, including generative AI, large language model applications, intelligent agents, and machine learning systems.
Experience leading delivery across multiple products or business domains in a matrixed environment.
Strong expertise in agentic AI architectures , Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG , semantic search, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and AI orchestration frameworks.
Hands-on technical expertise in Python and cloud-native application development, with Azure preferred.
Experience implementing and operating MLOps , LLMOps , and AgentOps capabilities in production environments.
Experience establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, development accelerators, and operational best practices.
Knowledge of responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy requirements, model governance, and enterprise risk controls.
Strong leadership capabilities with experience coaching engineers, leading technical teams, and driving organizational capability growth.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to connect technical solutions to measurable business outcomes.

Job Description Summary:
Job Summary
Supply Chain Digital Enablement applies data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to improve planning, service, cost, resilience, and execution across the North America Operating Unit. Our teams turn complex operational decisions into scalable digital capabilities that create measurable value for customers, bottlers, and the business.
Our work spans demand planning, inventory and replenishment, transportation, manufacturing, customer service, and network decisions. Strong data foundations, rigorous experimentation, optimization, and responsible AI are essential to building solutions that teams trust and use.
About the Role
As a Data Scientist in Supply Chain Digital Enablement, you will build analytical products that improve how supply-chain teams make decisions. You will partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Product, Engineering, Data, Commercial, and Finance colleagues to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable models, optimization tools, simulations, and AI-enabled decision support.
This role combines statistical analysis, predictive modeling, optimization, simulation, and modern AI techniques. You will lead the technical direction for complex, high-value solutions and establish reusable architecture, MLOps, evaluation, and governance practices that raise capability across the team. We are looking for someone with intellectual curiosity, technical rigor, practical supply-chain judgment, and a collaborative approach to delivery.
What You Will Do
Develop, evaluate, and productionize predictive, prescriptive, optimization, simulation, and NLP models for supply-chain decisions
Translate planning, inventory, transportation, manufacturing, network, and service problems into clear analytical requirements, model approaches, and measurable outcomes
Design ML architectures and rapid prototypes; partner with Engineering and Data teams to scale successful solutions into reliable products
Apply optimization and simulation methods, evaluating algorithmic complexity, performance, scalability, and trade-offs
Apply statistical analysis, forecasting, causal methods, and experimental design to evaluate interventions and quantify business impact
Partner with data engineering to ensure trustworthy data architecture, scalable pipelines, robust querying, instrumentation, and data-quality foundations
Build model lifecycle practices including reproducibility, versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and documentation
Evaluate and apply deep learning, large language models, NLP, and agentic systems where they create measurable value with appropriate controls and human oversight
Apply AI governance, privacy, security, fairness, explainability, and responsible-AI principles throughout development and deployment
Communicate technical choices, assumptions, insights, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders
Contribute to cross-functional software lifecycle management from discovery and prototyping through deployment, adoption, support, and continuous improvement
Define technical strategy, reference architectures, and modeling standards for priority supply-chain data-science products
Mentor data scientists and review technical designs, model quality, deployment readiness, and responsible-AI controls
What You Will Need
Key Qualifications
7+ years applying data science, machine learning, optimization, forecasting, or advanced analytics in a business, digital, operations, or supply-chain environment
Demonstrated technical leadership delivering complex data-science products from problem definition through production adoption and measurable business impact
Advanced Python and SQL skills and experience designing scalable data, model, and ML architecture patterns
Deep expertise in several of predictive modeling, optimization, simulation, statistical inference, experimental design, NLP, deep learning, or agentic systems
Experience designing MLOps practices including CI/CD, model registries, testing, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, and incident response
Ability to evaluate algorithmic complexity, trade-offs, scalability, explainability, and operating cost when selecting solution approaches
Experience establishing responsible-AI and model-governance practices, including documentation, review, risk controls, and human-in-the-loop decision design
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, guide cross-functional delivery, and mentor other data scientists
Preferred Qualifications
Significant supply-chain experience in demand planning, inventory, replenishment, manufacturing, logistics, network design, route optimization, or service operations
Experience leading enterprise-scale optimization, simulation, ML-platform, or AI-product initiatives
Experience setting technical standards across Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, and Software Engineering teams
Experience assessing and deploying generative-AI, NLP, deep-learning, or agentic solutions in governed production environments
Skills
Model development and optimization: Builds reliable predictive, prescriptive, optimization, and simulation models that improve supply-chain decisions
ML architecture and lifecycle management: Designs scalable prototypes and production-ready patterns; applies testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement practices
Statistical rigor: Applies sound statistical methods, experimental design, forecasting, and causal reasoning to quantify impact and reduce uncertainty
Data architecture and querying: Works effectively with complex data, SQL, pipelines, and data-quality practices to create trustworthy analytical foundations
AI and responsible innovation: Applies deep learning, NLP, LLMs, and agentic systems thoughtfully, with governance, ethics, explainability, and human oversight
Business partnership: Connects technical work to supply-chain outcomes and communicates clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders
Technical leadership: Sets direction, raises technical standards, mentors others, and aligns cross-functional teams around scalable solutions

Job Description Summary:
Location: Atlanta, GA
Reports To: Vice President, Marketing Data - North America
Function: NAOU Marketing
Team Overview
The North America Marketing Data team is responsible for building the data foundation, engineering capabilities, and data science and AI solutions that enable better marketing decisions across North America. The organization connects consumer data, technology, and insights to create scalable capabilities that improve consumer understanding, marketing effectiveness, measurement, personalization, and AI-enabled decision-making.
Role Overview
The Principal Data Scientist will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for framing, developing, deploying, and improving predictive, causal, and agentic data science solutions using consumer and marketing data. The role will create measurable value across consumer understanding, segmentation, propensity, personalization, measurement, forecasting, optimization, and decision support.
Working closely with Marketing, Human Sciences, Analytics, Data Engineering, Architecture, MarTech, and enterprise technology teams, this player-coach will translate business questions into production-ready models and reusable data science capabilities. The role will write and review code, establish scientific and MLOps standards, and guide solutions from exploration through adoption across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud.
What You Will Do for Us
Develop Predictive Consumer Models
Personally build and validate segmentation, propensity, consumer value, response, recommendation, forecasting, and optimization models using first-party, second-party, and third-party consumer and marketing data.
Advance Marketing Measurement and Experimentation
Apply experimentation, causal inference, incrementality, attribution, and statistical validation to evaluate marketing impact, improve media and channel decisions, and identify the next best action.
Design Agentic Data Science Solutions
Build agents that combine trusted consumer data, predictive models, retrieval, and tools for insight generation, planning, measurement, and activation. Include human review, evaluation, and clear guardrails.
Build on Azure and Google Cloud
Develop and deploy solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, Databricks, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Spark, MLflow, and approved enterprise technologies.
Operationalize Models at Scale
Establish feature pipelines, model registries, automated tests, CI/CD, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, documentation, and observability for reliable production use.
Apply Responsible AI and Data Governance
Embed privacy, consent, security, fairness, explainability, auditability, and approved-data-use controls into predictive models and agentic solutions.
Drive Adoption and Technical Leadership
Partner with marketers and technical teams to define success measures, explain model results and limits, support adoption, and mentor data scientists and engineers through code and design reviews.
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of hands-on data science, machine learning, or AI experience, including technical leadership and delivery of production models for consumer or marketing use cases.
Expert Python and strong SQL and PySpark skills; experience with scikit-learn, XGBoost, SparkML, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or comparable frameworks.
Deep knowledge of predictive modeling, causal inference, experimentation, forecasting, recommendations, optimization, feature engineering, explainability, and statistical validation.
Experience using first-party, second-party, and third-party consumer, media, CRM, commerce, loyalty, and marketing data, including identity, consent, quality, and privacy considerations.
Hands-on experience building and deploying data science solutions across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, including Fabric, Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Spark, and MLflow.
Strong MLOps and data engineering skills across feature pipelines, distributed processing, APIs, GitHub, CI/CD, containers, model serving, monitoring, drift controls, and production support.
Experience designing agentic AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, tool calling, orchestration, evaluation, human oversight, and responsible AI practices; ability to explain technical work in clear business terms.

Job Description Summary:
The Coca-Cola Company is seeking a highly motivated Cybersecurity Auditor with a focus on Network & Firewall Management and Operational Technology (OT) to join the Internal Audit Team. This role is responsible for providing independent assurance and advisory services related to cybersecurity risks, controls, governance, and compliance, with a primary focus on network security, firewall management, and operational technology security.
The position partners with business, technology, Information Security, Risk Management, and Compliance stakeholders to assess whether network security controls effectively protect organizational assets, support regulatory requirements, and align with enterprise risk objectives.
The role also evaluates broader cybersecurity risks, including network segmentation, intrusion prevention, cloud network security, remote access security, third-party connectivity, operational technology environments, and cybersecurity governance. Experience in Artificial Intelligence governance, security, and risk management is considered a plus.
What You’ll Do for Us:
Execute risk-based audits, advisory reviews, and assessments focused on network security, firewall management, operational technology environments, network segmentation, intrusion prevention, and related cybersecurity controls.
Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of controls that prevent, detect, and respond to unauthorized access across enterprise networks, cloud environments, OT networks, industrial control systems, and critical technology infrastructure.
Assess the governance, administration, and security of enterprise firewalls, cloud-native network security services, network access controls, and related perimeter defense technologies.
Review firewall rule management, network configuration management, and change management processes, including provisioning, approvals, implementation, monitoring, recertification, and decommissioning activities.
Evaluate network architecture and segmentation strategies across corporate, cloud, operational technology, and vendor-connected environments to determine whether critical assets are appropriately isolated and protected.
Assess controls supporting remote access solutions, VPN technologies, third-party connectivity, internet-facing systems, DMZ environments, identity-aware network controls, and Zero Trust architectures.
Evaluate the effectiveness of security monitoring capabilities, including intrusion detection and prevention systems, network detection and response solutions, security event monitoring, logging, alerting, and threat detection processes.
Assess security controls over network infrastructure and related technologies, including routers, switches, wireless networks, load balancers, cloud networking components, industrial network devices, and supporting management platforms.
Review cybersecurity controls within operational technology environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA systems, manufacturing networks, facility technologies, and other critical infrastructure components.
Evaluate controls supporting hybrid network environments, cloud networking services, network segmentation models, and Zero Trust security architectures.
Review controls over internet-facing services, administrative network access, network service accounts, machine-to-machine communications, and vendor connectivity.
Evaluate governance and security controls supporting cloud networking, APIs, infrastructure integrations, and interconnected enterprise environments.
Assess segmentation controls, network zoning, access restriction mechanisms, and perimeter defense frameworks.
Evaluate monitoring, logging, alerting, and detective controls designed to identify unauthorized network activity, anomalous traffic patterns, potential intrusions, and network security events.
Utilize data analytics and technology-enabled audit techniques to analyze firewall rulesets, network configurations, traffic patterns, connectivity paths, security events, and anomalous network activity.
Identify control deficiencies, emerging threats, cybersecurity risks, and opportunities to strengthen network security, OT security, infrastructure resilience, and protection of enterprise assets.
Develop clear, practical, and risk-informed recommendations that enhance network security, perimeter defenses, OT security, infrastructure resilience, and overall cybersecurity maturity.
Monitor emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and regulatory developments.
Evaluate cybersecurity risks associated with digital transformation initiatives and evolving network architectures.
Consider cybersecurity implications related to cloud adoption, software-defined networking, automation, and new technologies.
Support audit coverage of Artificial Intelligence governance, AI-enabled business processes, and AI security risks when applicable.
Identify technology and cybersecurity trends that may affect organizational risk exposure.
Utilize data analytics and technology-enabled auditing techniques to enhance audit effectiveness.
Analyze firewall rulesets, network traffic, security logs, threat intelligence data, and network activity to identify risk indicators.
Leverage automation and analytical tools to improve audit efficiency and coverage.
Build collaborative relationships with Information Security, Network Engineering, Infrastructure Teams, Risk Management, Compliance, and business leaders.
Communicate audit observations and risk insights effectively to management.
Assist in preparing audit reports, presentations, and executive communications.
Support issue validation and remediation monitoring activities.
Position Details:
Location: Atlanta, Georgia
Travel: 30% domestic and international
Individual contributor role - no direct reports
Qualifications & Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Two to five years of experience in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Network Security, IT Audit, Cybersecurity Audit, Firewall Administration, Network Engineering, Operational Technology Security, or related disciplines.
Understanding of cybersecurity principles, risks, controls, and governance practices.
Knowledge of network security concepts and control frameworks.
Understanding of:
Network architecture and security principles
Network segmentation and micro-segmentation
Firewall administration and rule management
Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems
Network Detection and Response solutions
Virtual Private Networks
Cloud network security
Operational Technology, Industrial Control Systems, and SCADA security concepts
Security monitoring, logging, and incident detection processes
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience auditing or administering network security technologies such as Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco Firepower, Fortinet, Juniper, Zscaler, Claroty, or similar platforms.
Experience auditing cloud network security environments such as Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud.
Experience assessing operational technology environments, industrial control systems, manufacturing technology, SCADA environments, or critical infrastructure security controls.
Familiarity with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, COBIT, CIS Controls, or similar frameworks.
Professional certifications such as:
CISA
CISSP
CRISC
Security+
CISM
CCNP Security
Nice to Have:
Experience in Artificial Intelligence governance, AI risk management, and AI security concepts.
Experience assessing controls related to AI development, deployment, or usage.
Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, model risk considerations, and AI data protection controls.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools for audit planning, testing, analytics, or reporting.
Other Skills:
This position requires expertise or competency in the following cybersecurity and technology areas:
Network Security
Firewall Management
Network Architecture
Network Segmentation and Micro-Segmentation
Cloud Network Security
Operational Technology Security
Industrial Control Systems Security
SCADA Security
Intrusion Detection and Prevention
Network Detection and Response
Zero Trust security concepts
Security monitoring and logging
Security governance
Technology controls
Data analytics
The position also requires expertise or competency in the following audit and risk areas:
Risk-based auditing
Internal controls
Root cause analysis
Issue identification and validation
Regulatory compliance
The successful candidate combines strong cybersecurity expertise with deep knowledge of network security, firewall management, and operational technology security, leveraging risk insights, analytics, and emerging technology awareness to provide assurance over critical network, perimeter, and industrial control system security controls.
The candidate must demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, effective communication skills, and a commitment to protecting enterprise value through risk-informed assurance across modern enterprise, cloud, and operational technology environments.

Job Description Summary:
Digital data products are central to how the North America Operating Unit (NAOU) Supply Chain plans, executes, and continuously improves end‑to‑end performance across sourcing, manufacturing, transportation, and customer fulfillment. Our Supply Chain Digital Enablement Team builds enterprise‑scale data products that create visibility, decision intelligence, and measurable business outcomes for planning, operations, and leadership across NAOU.
We are hiring a Lead Product Data Analyst to join our Supply Chain Digital Enablement Team. This role is embedded within empowered, cross‑functional product teams and partners closely with Product Managers, Data Architects, Data Engineers, Product Designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex supply chain data into trusted insights and scalable data products.
This is a Director-level role.
About the Role
Product Data Analysts are core contributors to the design, development, and adoption of supply chain data products. In this role, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy in complex, ambiguous problem spaces, helping teams understand operational performance, evaluate opportunities, and measure outcomes across the end‑to‑end supply chain.
You will lead sophisticated analyses, shape data models and metrics, and influence prioritization and trade‑offs by grounding decisions in data. Beyond executing analysis, you will help elevate analytical standards across the organization by modeling strong analytical practice, strengthening measurement discipline, and enabling self‑service insight for product teams and stakeholders.
This role is a strong fit for someone who thrives at the intersection of supply chain operations, data engineering, and advanced analytics—turning complex, multi‑source operational data into clear insight, reliable reporting, and decision‑ready products.
What You Will Do
Supply Chain Analytics & Insight
Develop a deep understanding of end‑to‑end supply chain processes and data, including procurement, manufacturing, inventory, transportation, and customer fulfillment.
Analyze large, complex datasets to identify performance drivers, risks, trade‑offs, and improvement opportunities across planning and execution.
Translate operational and optimization data into actionable insights that inform product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business priorities.
Go beyond describing what happened to explain why it happened and what actions should follow.
Proactively surface insights that help teams focus on the highest‑value opportunities.
Informally mentor analysts and partners through collaboration, review, and shared best practices.
Data Product Development & Measurement
Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define product objectives, success metrics, KPIs, and outcome‑based measures.
Design, maintain, and document analytical models, metrics, and business logic that support scalable data products and decision intelligence.
Support movement from static reporting toward reusable, trusted data assets and analytical products.
Advise on the appropriate level of analytical rigor based on decision risk, business value, and operational impact.
Data Quality, Modeling & Integration
Work closely with data architect and data engineering teams to define, validate, and evolve data models in Microsoft Azure.
Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reliable, and aligned to supply chain process realities.
Act as a steward of data quality, metric definitions, and analytical assumptions across products.
Document data logic, metrics, and methodologies to support transparency, reuse, and auditability.
Insight Communication & Influence
Create dashboards, analytical views, and narratives that make complex supply chain data accessible and actionable.
Communicate insights clearly to technical and non‑technical audiences, including supply chain leaders.
Contribute to a data‑informed culture by raising analytical fluency across supply chain product teams.
Collaborate with other analysts, data architects, data engineers, and data scientists to align insight across domains.
Tools & Technologies
This role will actively use and support data products built on:
Microsoft Azure Synapse Analytics and Microsoft Fabric.
PySpark Notebooks for data exploration, transformation, and analysis.
Microsoft Azure Pipelines for analytics workflows and data product deployment.
SQL‑based analytics across large‑scale enterprise datasets.
Visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI.
What You Will Need
Key Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, economics, computer science, industrial engineering, supply chain, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence supporting complex operational or supply chain domains.
Advanced SQL querying and mastery of Python or another scripting language, including PySpark.
Extensive experience working with supply chain data from systems such as SAP S/4HANA (e.g., procurement, inventory, planning, manufacturing, order‑to‑cash), Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and other supply chain systems.
Statistical methods and modeling techniques, with working knowledge of machine learning models.
Data quality assessment, validation, and root cause investigation.
Proven ability to influence decisions through data and clear communication.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working within cross‑functional product or platform teams.
Ability to work independently and to foster a data-driven culture of growth.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in a related quantitative or supply chain field.
Experience supporting enterprise‑scale supply chain data platforms or analytics products.
Experience applying forecasting and optimization modeling to supply chain planning, execution, or operational decision-making.
Knowledge of Azure and Microsoft Fabric storage and compute concepts that support scalable analytics products.
Skills
Analytical Rigor: Breaks down complex operational questions into clear, structured analyses using SQL, scripting, statistical methods, and root cause investigation.
Supply Chain Acumen: Understands end‑to‑end supply chain processes and metrics.
Product & Systems Thinking: Connects data insight to scalable data products and business outcomes.
Data Storytelling: Communicates insights with clarity through visuals and narratives.
Collaboration & Influence: Builds trust across supply chain, product, and technology partners.

Job Description Summary:
At The Coca-Cola Company, we are connecting the power of technology with the scale of our global operations to create secure, digitally confident systems that drive growth. Cybersecurity is at the heart of this commitment, ensuring our platforms, data, and operational environments remain protected as we transform in an increasingly complex and connected world.
We are seeking an Information Technology Auditor with deep cybersecurity expertise to join our Internal Audit team. This role is integral to safeguarding enterprise resilience by assessing technology controls across cloud platforms, digital ecosystems, industrial control systems, and data privacy frameworks. You will serve as a Cybersecurity Subject Matter Expert (SME), partnering closely with senior IT and security leaders to identify emerging risks, evaluate control strategies, and ensure compliance with globally recognized standards, including SOX requirements.
If you have strong technical curiosity, proven experience in IT audit or cybersecurity, and a passion for applying risk-based thinking to dynamic technology environments, this opportunity offers a unique platform to influence operational integrity across a company that refreshes the world every day.
What You’ll Do for Us
Serve as an internal Cybersecurity SME within the Internal Audit function, conducting audits and advisory activities related to cybersecurity, IT compliance, and technology risk.
Develop audit strategies for technology-focused engagements by contributing methodologies, risk-based approaches, and alignment with prior audit results.
Perform interviews with process and business owners to gather insights on operational practices, expected controls, and areas of potential vulnerability.
Independently execute established audit tests to evaluate effectiveness of security measures, IT controls, and governance processes across global environments.
Apply frameworks such as NIST, PCI, COBIT, and others to assess cybersecurity posture and recommend control enhancements.
Analyze findings using professional skepticism and risk-awareness; document judgment-based conclusions and ensure recommendations address root causes effectively.
Prepare detailed audit reports communicating observations, risk implications, and corrective actions in an accurate and concise format.
Collaborate with IT leaders and stakeholders on remediation plans for identified gaps, ensuring alignment with business priorities and compliance standards.
Maintain awareness of evolving technologies—cloud services, ERP platforms, industrial control systems—and emerging cybersecurity threats to inform audit scope and focus.
Participate in continuous improvement of audit methodologies and contribute ideas for leveraging analytics and automation within audit processes.
Requirements & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, or related discipline.
3–4 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT audit, security engineering, or technology-focused public accounting engagements.
Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM preferred; additional technical credentials (e.g., CEH, OSCP) advantageous.
Strong knowledge of IT control frameworks (COBIT, PCI DSS, NIST) and ability to apply them in risk-based auditing environments.
Familiarity with technologies such as SAP ECC/HANA, SAP GRC, Active Directory, RedHat Linux, Windows OS, Oracle Database, MS SQL Server, AWS, Azure Cloud, Microsoft 365, Palo Alto Networks, and network/ICS equipment.
Understanding of general IT control principles including security operations, system administration, program governance, change management, and privacy standards.
Proficiency across modern development models (DevOps, Agile) and awareness of data governance and incident management processes.
Strong analytical and quantitative ability; comfortable working with probabilities, ratios, and statistical measures to identify risk trends.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to clearly present risks, negotiate corrective actions, and engage stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally; flexibility to accommodate department needs and extended projects.
Demonstrated initiative and aptitude for learning new technologies and adapting to evolving business environments with minimal supervision.
